c74object.name: evi_zeroxcount
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Like MSP zerox~ with controls for window size and threshold, with simultaneous analysis outputs
c74object.description:
evi_zeroxcount is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_zeroxcount is also available in MSP as: evi.zeroxcount~.
This was built for a very specific need but might be useful as a controller. It is very similar to the RNBO 'zerox_count~' object but with simultaneous outlets for a > threshold gate and running # of crossings.

geninlet.name: input
geninlet.digest: The audio input to be analysed for zero crossings.

geninlet.name: reset
geninlet.digest: Reset internal state, useful in some situaations.

attribute.name: size
attribute.description: The size of the analysis window with which to count zero crossings in. By default this is 'vectorsize' which is a typical use case.

attribute.name: thresh
attribute.description: If count divided by window size is greater than this threshold, report a gate event (middle outlet).
